advisor_enabled.description: Master switch for the Uganda Weather Hybrid AI Advisor.

advisor_cloud_model.description: Cloud fallback Gemini model name for Firebase AI Logic.

advisor_max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for cloud weather briefings.

advisor_prefer_on_device.description: Prefer on-device Gemini Nano execution before cloud fallback when online.

advisor_tts_enabled.description: Enable client-side Firebase AI Logic neural TTS for English weather briefings.

advisor_tts_model.description: Gemini TTS model used via Firebase AI Logic for natural spoken English output.

advisor_tts_voice.description: Prebuilt neural voice persona for Firebase AI Logic English speech synthesis.

advisor_tts_first_chunk_timeout_ms.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds for the opening English neural voice chunk before switching to the device voice.

advisor_tts_first_chunk_max_chars.description: Maximum character length of the opening sentence chunk so spoken replies start early on mobile networks.

advisor_tts_chunk_max_chars.description: Maximum character length for pipelined follow-up speech chunks.

advisor_voice_slow_rtt_ms.description: Round-trip latency threshold in milliseconds above which English switches immediately to the built-in device voice.

advisor_voice_slow_downlink_mbps.description: Downlink bandwidth threshold in Mbps below which English switches immediately to the built-in device voice.

advisor_prompt_template_id.description: Optional Firebase AI Logic Server Prompt Template ID (e.g. uganda-weather-advisor-v1) to keep cloud prompts server-side.
